KSI0/6-/0 — Survey and State Signatures Filed 7-14-2020 AMENDMENT NUMBER TWO TO LEASE AGREEMENT THIS AMENDMENT NUMBER TWO TO LEASE AGREEMENT (“Amendment Number Two”) is made and entered into this day of 201 tine “Effective Date”), by and between the State of Tennessee (the “State”) and Metropolitan Government of Nashville and Davidson County Tennessee (“Metro”). The State and Metro are hereinafter collectively referred to as the “Parties” or individually as a “Party”. RECITALS WHEREAS, the State and Metro entered into a certain Lease Agreement dated May 18, 1995 (the “Original Lease”); WHEREAS, the State and Metro mutually acknowledge and agree that the Original Lease is currently in effect and that neither of the Parties are in breach or default of the Original Lease; WHEREAS, the north end of the Farmers’ Market (the “NorthTract”), which is more particularly described in Schedule 1 and incorporated into this Amendment Number Two, is included in the Leased Premises; WHEREAS, the State and Metro mutually agree to amend the Original Lease as set forth below. NOW, THEREFORE, based upon the mutual promises contained herein and other good and valuable consideration, the receipt of which is hereby acknowledged, the State and Metro hereby agree to amend and modify the Original Lease as follows:
1. In exchange for the sum of four million dollars ($4,000,000) to be paid by the State to Metro, Metro has agreed that the northern portion of the property (“the North Tract”) containing the North Shed facility and adjacent parking lot shall no longer be a part of the “Leased Premise” or subject to the terms and conditions of the Original Lease or any amendment thereto. Accordingly, the Original Lease is hereby amended by excluding the property described on Schedule 1 of this Amendment from the description of the Leased Premises found in Exhibit A of the Original Lease.
2. Metro shall have right to ingress and egress to the North Tract at a location designated by the State for the for purposes of loading and unloading supplies at the north dock area. {N0037938.1} AMENDMENT NUMBER TWO LEASE AGREEMENT Page 1 of 4 ARCHIVE
3. Metro shall have from the date of execution of this lease amendment until April 30, 2016 to utilize the North Tract and shall assume all maintenance associated with the property for said time period. Upon completion of the new parking lot by the State on the North Tract, said parking lot shall be available for use by both the Farmers’ Market and the State for the duration of the Lease (40 years including renewals). The State shall provide Metro with at least 15 days prior written notice of an event which will require the State’s exclusive use of the parking lot for events and for a specified period of time.
4. The State is not bound by this Amendment Number Two until it is signed by the Parties and approved by appropriate officials in accordance with applicable Tennessee laws and regulations.
5. This Agreement shall not be effective until the terms of this Amendment have been approved by a resolution of the Metropolitan Council and authorized by the Metropolitan Mayor.
6. The revisions set forth herein shall be effective as of the date this Amendment Number Two is fully executed. All other terms and conditions of the Original Lease not expressly amended herein shall remain in full force and effect.
7. This instrument may be executed in one or more counterparts. It shall be fully executed when each Party whose signature is required has signed at least one (1) counterpart, even though no one (1) counterpart contains the signatures of all parties to this instrument. Electronic, scanned or facsimile signatures shall have the same force and effect as original signatures. All capitalized terms used but not defined in this Amendment Number Two shall have the meanings ascribed to them in the Original Lease. (SIGNATURE PAGE FOLLOWS) {N0037936, 1} AMENDMENT NUMBER TWO LEASE AGREEMENT Page 2 of 4 ARCHIVE
IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the Parties have affixed their signatures as of the date set forth above.
